newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bimantara unit, UPS in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Bimantara unit, UPS in joint venture.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Cardig Citra, a cargo handling service which is a unit of conglomerate PT Bimantara Citra, said on Thursday it has signed a memorandum of understanding with United Parcel Service (UPS) of the United States to form a joint-venture courier firm.
"The negotiation has been going on for around one year. We expect the joint venture to be formed by the end of June," Cardig Citra president-director Djattie Soedradjat told reporters.
UPS currently operates in Indonesian through PT Cardig Citra Primajasa, which acts as its agent. Primajasa is wholly owned by Cardig Air, which is a Bimantara subsidiary.
Soedradjat declined to reveal the possible share composition or other details of the joint venture, saying the negotiation has not been completed.
Bimantara, controlled by President Suharto's second son Bambang Trihatmodjo, has interests ranging from automotive, broadcasting, property to electronics.
UPS said in a statement it had revenues in excess of $22 billion in 1996.
